title: Cross-functional dependency signal hub and commitment matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Roadmap work across Eng, Design, Security and Infra is frequently blocked by unclear ownership of transitive dependencies and late discovery of scope mismatches. We lack a single operational view that combines readiness signals (design signoff, security gating, infra capacity), commitment dates, and fallback options.

Goal: Deliver a lightweight "Signal Hub" and Commitment Matrix that:
- Aggregates readiness signals from teams (Design, Eng, Security, Infra).
- Surfaces high-risk dependency lines for the next two cycles with computed risk scores.
- Assigns a primary and secondary owner per dependency and publishes a simple remediation playbook for missed commitments.
- Provides an API/wizard for PMs to declare dependencies at initiative creation and link to Linear issues.

Scope: MVP focuses on Roadmap-level dependencies for company-level initiatives and top-50 customer-impacting features over the next 3 cycles. Not in scope: per-PR dependency automation or full-scale IRL handoff ceremony.

Approach: Build a central datastore in the Console that ingests declared dependencies (from Linear webhooks / manual UI), team readiness checklists, and signals (design artifacts uploaded, security review status, infra capacity booking). Compute a risk score (urgency x dependency broadness x slack) and render a matrix per initiative. Add Slack alerts for breaches and an on-call escalation channel for high-risk items.
acceptance_criteria: Signal Hub UI shows at least 3 readiness signals per dependency (Design, Security, Infra or Eng) and maps to a Linear issue.
Every declared dependency has a primary and secondary owner assigned and persisted in Linear custom fields or the Console registry.
Risk score algorithm is implemented and documented; top 10% highest-risk items trigger automatic Slack alerts to owners.
A Commitment Matrix CSV export is available and matches the dashboard state for auditing.
Runbook for missed commitment (escalation steps and temporary fallback models) is authored and linked from each high-risk dependency card.
success_metrics: Reduce cross-team blocked days on roadmap initiatives by 30% within two quarters.
90% of high-risk dependencies have an assigned secondary owner.
Enable PMs to declare dependencies at initiative creation in under 3 minutes (measured in UX tests).
Decrease the number of last-week-before-release dependency escalations by 40% compared to prior quarter.
